setup: Bench side-on, square to the bar
Pad the bar, sit with it over your hips
Upper back on the bench edge
execution: Unhook the bar at the bottom
Tuck your chin and ribs down
Drive your hips up through your heels
Squeeze at the top, lower under control
faults: Don't arch your lower back at the top

notes: Set the safety stops just below the bar's lowest point so it can't land on your hips. Rehook the bar at the end of the set.
Wedge the bench against the machine frame or use a heavy bench so it can't slide back.
Use a bar pad or folded mat across the hips.
Smith bars differ in weight and some are counterbalanced. Log the plates added; numbers aren't comparable between gyms or with a barbell hip thrust.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move

keyPositions.label: Bottom
keyPositions.describe: Upper back on the bench edge, hips low, bar resting across the hip crease on a pad. Knees bent, feet flat. Chin tucked.

keyPositions.label: Top
keyPositions.describe: Hips driven up until the body is level from knees to shoulders. Shins about vertical, ribs down, bar still over the hips.

ikHints: Upper back pivots on the bench edge
Bar stays on the hip crease

emphasise: Hips rise to a level line, ribs down
Bar moves straight up on its track
